instanceUpdate.confirmHeading: How the update keeps your data safe.
instanceUpdate.confirmBody: Solid Memo updates the documents of {name} one by one, each where it is, in a single write that your Pod makes whole or not at all and, where your Pod checks this, only if nothing else changed it since Solid Memo read it. Every document can be read throughout, whether it is updated yet or not. One that cannot be updated now, because it changed elsewhere meanwhile, say, is left as it is, and you can try again: then only what is still outdated is updated. Every address stays the same, and so does who you shared it with.

migrationNotice.howItWorks: Updating brings each document up to date on its own, where it is, one after another, each in a single write that your Pod makes whole or not at all. Every document can be read throughout, updated or not; one that cannot be updated now is left as it is, and you can try again. Every address stays the same; deck names, card text, directions, your review history and your settings stay as they are.

findable.intro: Other Solid apps find your data through the type indexes in your Pod: one registration for each kind of data, saying where it is. storagePicker.heading: Choose a storage
storagePicker.intro: A storage is a place in your Pod where Solid Memo can keep its folder. Usually there is just one: your Pod itself.
storagePicker.empty: No storage was found for your WebID. Enter your pod's root URL below.

study.heading: Study: {deck}
study.nothingToday: Nothing to study today — come back tomorrow!
study.putBack: You'll see the last card again later in this session.
study.gradePrompt: How well did you remember it?

keys.reveal: Press Space to reveal the answer.

cram.heading: Cram: {deck}
cram.notice: Nothing is recorded here: your answers don't change any due date, your statistics, or which cards are leeches.

cram.nothingAll: None of your decks has a leech to cram.

validation.heading: Validation of {name}
validation.newer: {name} — {shape} format {version} is newer than this app knows (up to {latest}); skipped.
validation.profiled: {name} — not a Solid Memo subject; DCAT-AP says:
validation.foreign: {name} — written by another app; Solid Memo only warns about it:

constraint.Datatype: The value has the wrong datatype.
constraint.Class: The value is not of the right class.
constraint.NodeKind: The value is of the wrong kind (an IRI or a literal).
constraint.In: The value is not one of those allowed.
constraint.Pattern: The value does not have the right form.
constraint.Or: None of the allowed alternatives holds.
constraint.Xone: Exactly one of the alternatives must hold.
constraint.Not: The value is something it must not be.
constraint.Node: The value does not conform to its shape.
constraint.UniqueLang: The same language is used for more than one value.
constraint.LanguageIn: The text is in a language not allowed here.
constraint.QualifiedMinCount: Too few values of the required kind.
constraint.QualifiedMaxCount: Too many values of a certain kind.
constraint.Closed: The property is not allowed here.
constraint.DeckPlace: This deck's entry is not in its instance's catalog, or it names a document at an address no deck's documents may have, such as another resource's access control or one of the instance's own documents. Solid Memo does not use it.
constraint.DateTimeRange: This date is too far in the future or the past for Solid Memo to read, so it reads as no date.

webIdForm.help: Your WebID is the web address that identifies you, given to you by your Pod provider. You will log in on your provider's own page — Solid Memo never sees your password.

workspace.developerModeOff: Developer mode is off. Turn it on in {preferences} to check this instance against Solid Memo's shapes.
workspace.deckSetAside: This deck is set aside: its data does not conform. Repair it above to use it again.
workspace.checkFailed: Could not check this instance's data: {error}
workspace.triedUnknown: The deck that link leads to is not in the library. Here is what the library has.

errors.cardFrontImageNotWebUrl: The front image must be an http(s) URL.
errors.cardBackImageNotWebUrl: The back image must be an http(s) URL.
errors.cardFrontEmpty: The front needs text or an image.
errors.cardBackEmpty: The back needs text or an image.
errors.textLanguageTaken: There is already text in {language}. Edit or remove it first.
errors.textMixesUnstated: This text does not say which language it is in, so it cannot have translations. Choose its language first.
errors.distractorPublished: This wrong option is in the release the deck came from, so it cannot be deleted. Retire it instead.
errors.dailyLimitInvalid: A daily limit is a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.dueDayInvalid: “{day}” is not a day. Choose the day the card is due.
errors.cardTransferSameDeck: The cards are in this deck already. Choose another deck.
errors.licenseUnknown: Choose one of the licenses offered.
errors.authorTwice: {author} is named twice. Name each author once.
errors.paletteUnreadable: The text is too faint to read on the background (less than 3:1). Choose colors further apart.
errors.paletteContrastLow: Some colors have less contrast than they need. Choose others, or use them anyway.
errors.noCatalogToUpdate: This instance has no catalog yet. Update the instance in Solid Memo first.
errors.noMetaToUpdate: This instance has no description to update. Reload the page and try again.
errors.webIdInvalidUrl: That is not a valid URL. A WebID looks like https://you.example/profile/card#me.
errors.webIdNotHttps: A WebID must start with https://.
errors.webIdWithCredentials: A WebID must not contain a username or password.
errors.providerNotHttps: An identity provider must be an https:// URL.
errors.webIdNoSubject: Your WebID profile does not describe you. Check that you entered your WebID exactly, with the part after #, or pick your provider instead.
errors.webIdNoIssuer: Your WebID profile does not say where you log in. Pick your provider instead of entering your WebID.
errors.webIdIssuerNotHttps: Your WebID profile names a place to log in that is not a secure https:// address. Pick your provider instead of entering your WebID.
errors.profileNoSubject: Your profile does not describe you, so Solid Memo cannot note in it where your data is. Check your profile with your Pod provider, then try again.
errors.privateTypeIndexNotLinked: Solid Memo could not link its private list of your data from your profile. Check that Solid Memo may edit your profile, then try again.
errors.publicTypeIndexNotLinked: Solid Memo could not link its public list of your data from your profile. Check that Solid Memo may edit your profile, then try again.
errors.typeIndexNoStorage: Your profile names no storage of yours, so Solid Memo has nowhere to keep its list of your data. Ask your Pod provider to add your Pod's storage to your profile, then try again.
errors.storageInaccessible: Solid Memo cannot open that storage. Check the address, and that you are logged in with the account that owns it.
errors.notAnInstanceNoMeta: That address is not a Solid Memo instance. Check that you pasted the address of an instance's folder, ending in /.
errors.notAnInstanceNoSubject: That folder is not a Solid Memo instance: its description cannot be read. Check that you pasted the right address.

movedCopyInvalid.one: The copy in your Pod is not in the format Solid Memo expects ({count} problem), so your study is left as it was. Try again later.
movedCopyInvalid.other: The copy in your Pod is not in the format Solid Memo expects ({count} problems), so your study is left as it was. Try again later.

errors.guestUrlsLeft: The copy in your Pod still points to the guest's study, so your study is left as it was. Try again.

guestStudyInvalid.one: Part of your study in this browser is not in the format Solid Memo expects ({count} problem), so none of it was added to your Pod. It is still here.
guestStudyInvalid.other: Part of your study in this browser is not in the format Solid Memo expects ({count} problems), so none of it was added to your Pod. It is still here.

errors.guestStudyTooNew: A newer version of Solid Memo saved part of your study in this browser, so this version does not add it to your Pod. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.guestStudyChanged: Your study in this browser changed while it was being added, perhaps in another tab, so it is kept here. Try again to add what changed.
errors.instanceChangedDuringCopy: Your study in this browser changed while it was being copied, perhaps in another tab, so it is kept here. Try again.
errors.resourceChangedDuringCopy: Part of your study in this browser changed while it was being copied, perhaps in another tab, so it is kept here. Try again.
errors.guestStudyBeingMoved: Solid Memo is moving your study in this browser into your Pod and saves nothing to it until that is done. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.writeRefused: Solid Memo stopped a change to your Pod for safety: it would have been saved at an address Solid Memo never saves to. Nothing was changed.
errors.deckChangedSinceOffer: The deck changed since the update was offered, perhaps in another tab or app, so nothing was changed. Look at the offer again.
errors.deckChangedDuringUpgrade: The deck changed while it was being updated, perhaps in another tab or app. Try again.
errors.changedElsewhere: This was changed elsewhere, perhaps in another tab or app, since Solid Memo read it, so nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.deckTreeChanged: Your decks were rearranged elsewhere, perhaps in another tab or app, so this change was not made. The list now shows them as they are.
errors.writtenByNewerApp: A newer version of Solid Memo has updated this data, so this version does not save over it. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.deckTreeTooNew: A newer version of Solid Memo arranged these decks, so this one cannot rearrange them. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.createdElsewhere: This was created elsewhere, perhaps in another tab or app, just as Solid Memo was about to create it, so nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.
errors.alreadyExists: Something is already kept at that place in your Pod. Choose another place.
errors.cannotCheck: Solid Memo could not check your Pod. Check your connection and try again.
errors.dataNotConforming: Solid Memo did not save this: it is not in the format Solid Memo expects. Nothing was changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.deckGone: The deck “{deck}” no longer exists. Perhaps it was removed in another tab or app.
errors.cardsDocumentGone: The cards of “{deck}” can no longer be found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.deckDocumentUnclaimed: Solid Memo did not change “{deck}”: its documents do not say they belong to this deck. Nothing was changed. Where the data check lists the deck, confirm that they are its documents, then try again.
errors.cardGone: That card no longer exists. Perhaps it was removed in another tab or app. Reload the page.
errors.notADeck: That is not a Solid Memo deck, so it cannot be added. Choose another deck.
errors.libraryDeckTooNew: This deck is in a newer format than this version of Solid Memo can read. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.libraryCardTooNew: A card in this deck is in a newer format than this version of Solid Memo can read. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.deckFileUnreadable: Solid Memo cannot read that file. Choose a Turtle or JSON-LD file exported from Solid Memo.
errors.notADeckFile: That file does not hold one Solid Memo deck. Choose a file exported from Solid Memo.
errors.deckFileTooNew: That file was written by a newer version of Solid Memo, so this one cannot import it. Reload the page to get the latest version.
errors.noGuestPod: There is no guest study on this device.
errors.guestPodStartFailed: The guest study on this device could not be opened. Reload the page and try again.
errors.guestStorageAborted: This browser refused to save a change to the guest study. Check that it has room to keep data, then try again.
errors.addFailed: Solid Memo could not save to your Pod. Check your connection and try again.
errors.draftGone: That draft no longer exists. Perhaps it was deleted in another tab or app.
errors.releaseUnreadable: Solid Memo cannot read a release at {url}. Check the address, and that the release is published there.
errors.notAReleaseFile: That file does not hold one deck or course release. Choose a release saved as Turtle or JSON-LD.
errors.draftIdUnsupported: This draft names a part of it “#{id}”, which a draft cannot keep: an id of a draft is letters A to Z, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter or digit. Solid Memo does not open or change it.
errors.releaseIdUnsupported: This release names a part of it “#{id}”, which a draft cannot keep: an id of a draft is letters A to Z, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter or digit. It cannot be made a draft.
errors.releaseTaken: A release is already published at {url}, and a release is never written over. Publish the next version, or choose another folder.

releaseHasErrors.one: The release check finds {count} error. Fix it before you publish the release.
releaseHasErrors.other: The release check finds {count} errors. Fix them before you publish the release.

errors.draftReleased: This draft was released already, at {url}, and is no longer changed. Start its next version instead.
errors.guestCannotPublish: A guest's study is kept in this browser alone, where no one else can read a release. Move your study into a Pod to publish it, or download the release as a file.
errors.publicAccessRefused: Your Pod did not let Solid Memo make the release at {url} public, so only you can read it. Try again, or make it readable by everyone with your Pod provider's tools.
errors.releaseUrlInvalid: That is not the address of a release. Paste its whole address, starting with https:// or http://.

releaseNotConforming.one: The release on {host} breaks Solid Memo's rules in {count} place, so it cannot be added. Ask its creator to check it.
releaseNotConforming.other: The release on {host} breaks Solid Memo's rules in {count} places, so it cannot be added. Ask its creator to check it.

statistics.heading: Statistics
statistics.empty: No answers yet: the statistics begin with your next study session.
statistics.emptyRange: No answers in this range. A longer range may show earlier ones.
statistics.coverage: Since {month}, your first month of study.
statistics.rememberedHint: Each card's first review of the day in each direction, recalled and graded by you. A card's first answer, a card back in the session the same day and course answers are not reviews.
statistics.quizHint: The share right of each course question's first answer of the day. Practice answers, and right answers to a card already graded that day, are not logged, so they are not counted.
statistics.activityLabel: Answers by day over the last {weeks} weeks: the stronger the green, the more answers.
statistics.pointAtDay: Point at a day (or use the arrow keys) to see what it held, or open the table below.
statistics.pointAtMonth: Point at a month (or use the arrow keys) to see how well it was remembered, or open the table below.
statistics.pointAtDayAhead: Point at a day (or use the arrow keys) to see what falls due, or open the table below.
statistics.introducedNote: A running total of the cards seen for the first time in the last 12 months, a card studied both ways counted once each way, removed decks and retired cards included.
statistics.introducedLabel: A line rising, day by day, with every card seen for the first time.
statistics.recallLabel: The share of reviews remembered each month, from 0 to 100%: young cards as a dashed line, mature cards as a solid one.
statistics.recallNote: Of each month's reviews, the share remembered. Young: reviewed at an interval under 21 days; mature: 21 days or more.
statistics.progressUnavailable: Your cards' progress cannot be read just now.
statistics.maturityHint: New: not reviewed yet. Relearning: forgotten last time and not remembered since. Young: reviewed at an interval under 21 days. Mature: 21 days or more. A card studied both ways counts once each way.
statistics.nothingHeldBack: Your daily review limit holds nothing back.

caughtUpIn.one: in {count} day, at your daily review limit
caughtUpIn.other: in {count} days, at your daily review limit

runOutDetail.one: at {count} new card a day, studying each day
runOutDetail.other: at {count} new cards a day, studying each day

statistics.runOutNeverDetail: This deck takes no new cards a day.
statistics.runOutOn: New cards run out on {date}, studying each day.
statistics.runOutNever: No new cards a day: they never run out.
statistics.intervalsLabel: Bars for how many cards, each way, come back after each span of days.
statistics.intervalsNote: SM-2 spaces a card's reviews 1 day apart, then 6 days, then about 15 and about 38, growing from there; FSRS-6 spaces them by each card's memory. Either way, some spans hold few cards.
statistics.easesLabel: Bars for how many cards, each way, have each ease: the higher, the faster their intervals grow.
statistics.easesNote: The ease is SM-2's, kept up to date on every review whichever scheduler sets the due days. Every card starts at 2.5. Easy raises it a little, Good keeps it, Hard lowers it, down to 1.3; forgetting a card leaves it as it is. The higher it is, the faster the card's intervals grow.
statistics.pointAtBar: Point at a bar (or use the arrow keys) to see its count, or open the table below.
statistics.forecastLabel: Pairs of bars for each of the next {count} days: the reviews falling due, today's including every overdue one, beside those your daily review limit lets through.
statistics.forecastNote: What your daily review limit holds back waits for the next day: studying each day, you would do the reviews within it.
statistics.dueTodayDetail: {date}, today: {reviews} due, overdue ones included, {capped} within your limit.
statistics.nothingDue: No reviews due in the next {count} days.
statistics.dayHeld: What each day held, the last {count} days
statistics.dayHeldLabel: Stacked bars for each of the last {count} days: reviews remembered, new cards, lapses and repeats.
statistics.dayHeldNote: Repeats: a card back in the session the same day. A course answer to a card seen before counts only among the day's answers.
statistics.buttonsNote: The button pressed for each card's first answer and for each review, recalled and graded by you; course answers and a card back in the session the same day are left out. On the 0 to 5 scale, 0 to 2 count as Again.
statistics.pointAtButton: Point at part of a bar (or use the arrow keys) to see its share, or open the table below.
statistics.weekdaysLabel: Bars for the answers on each weekday on average, Monday to Sunday.
statistics.weekdaysNote: Each weekday's answers divided by how many of that weekday there have been since your first study day in these figures.
statistics.pointAtWeekday: Point at a weekday (or use the arrow keys) to see what it held, or open the table below.
statistics.intake: New cards and reviews, by week
statistics.intakeLabel: Pairs of bars, one for each week: new cards beside reviews.
statistics.intakeNote: Every new card brings reviews in the weeks after it. If new cards keep outpacing the reviews you keep up with, take on fewer; the reviews due, further down, show what is coming.
statistics.pointAtWeek: Point at a week (or use the arrow keys) to see what it held, or open the table below.

hardestHint.one: The cards you forgot most often in their reviews over the last 12 months, either way. A card forgotten {count} time or more is a leech: it keeps costing reviews, so open it to make it clearer or add a note.
hardestHint.other: The cards you forgot most often in their reviews over the last 12 months, either way. A card forgotten {count} times or more is a leech: it keeps costing reviews, so open it to make it clearer or add a note.

statistics.noHardest: No card was forgotten in a review over the last 12 months.
statistics.confusionsHint: The wrong options chosen most often in this deck's course questions over the last 12 months.
statistics.noConfusions: No wrong option was chosen over the last 12 months.

leechesHint.one: Cards forgotten {count} time or more in their reviews over the last 12 months, in any deck. They keep costing reviews: open one to make it clearer or add a note.
leechesHint.other: Cards forgotten {count} times or more in their reviews over the last 12 months, in any deck. They keep costing reviews: open one to make it clearer or add a note.

statistics.noLeeches: No leeches: no card was forgotten that often.
statistics.cramLeechesHint: Practice them now, as often as you like. Nothing is recorded, so their due dates stay the same.
statistics.coursesHint: The chapters you have completed in each course, and how you answered each chapter's questions over the last 12 months: the share right of each question's first answer of the day.
statistics.allTimeHint: Your whole answer log: the tiles and charts of this range count all of it, and these three say how far you have come.
statistics.promptsDetail: Each once; a card studied both ways counts once each way.
statistics.cardsYouKnowDetail: Mature now: reviewed at 21 days or more
statistics.downloadHint: The answers of this range, saved on this device as a file a spreadsheet opens. Nothing is sent anywhere.
statistics.recallWeekLabel: The share of reviews remembered each week, from 0 to 100%: young cards as a dashed line, mature cards as a solid one.
statistics.recallWeekNote: Of each week's reviews, the share remembered. Young: reviewed at an interval under 21 days; mature: 21 days or more. By week while your reviews span up to 14 weeks, by month beyond.
statistics.recallWeekDetail: Week of {date}: young cards {young}, mature cards {mature}.
statistics.recallByIntervalLabel: A bar for each span of intervals, as tall as the share of its reviews remembered, from 0 to 100%.
statistics.recallByIntervalNote: Of the reviews after each span of days away, the share remembered. A card's reviews come 1 day apart, then 6 days, then about 15 and about 38, growing from there, so some spans hold few reviews: each share says how many it is of.
statistics.pointAtShare: Point at a bar (or use the arrow keys) to see its share and how many reviews it is of, or open the table below.
statistics.latenessLabel: A bar for each lateness, from on time to 30 days late or more, as tall as the share of its reviews remembered, from 0 to 100%.
statistics.latenessNote: Approximate: how many days after it fell due each review was done. Reviews now record the day they were due; for older ones it is worked out from the answer before it, and a review moved to a later day in the Studio counts as late. A review the daily review limit held back counts as late too. Unknown: an older review whose answer before it is older than the answers read, or whose card was moved or changed in the Studio.
statistics.lateEarly: Early, or moved earlier in the Studio
statistics.onTimePays: Reviews done on time: {onTime} remembered. Done late: {late}.
statistics.maturityOverTime: Young and mature cards over time
statistics.maturityOverTimeLabel: Two lines, week by week: how many cards were young (dashed) and how many mature (solid).
statistics.maturityOverTimeNote: Approximate: each card as its last answer by the end of the week left it, young or mature by the interval it gave, relearning when it was forgotten (in the table). Changes made in the Studio are not in your answers, so they are not counted. A card studied both ways counts once each way.
statistics.memorySpanLabel: A line, week by week: the median interval of your cards, in days.
statistics.memorySpanNote: Approximate: at the end of each week, the interval in the middle of your cards' intervals (half of them longer, half shorter), as their last answers left them. Changes made in the Studio are not counted.
statistics.noneMatured: No card grew mature in this range
statistics.studyTimeHint: Approximate, estimated from the times your answers were given: a pause of 5 minutes or more begins a new session, and a pause within one counts for 1 minute at most. Course answers are left out, so time spent in courses is not counted.
statistics.studyTimeRecordedHint: Since {date}, the app records how long each answer takes, in courses too, and counts those times. Before then, the time is estimated from when your answers were given: a pause of 5 minutes or more begins a new session, a pause within one counts for 1 minute at most, and course answers are left out.

timeUnknown.one: Of the answers in this range since then, {count} has no time recorded and is not counted.
timeUnknown.other: Of the answers in this range since then, {count} have no time recorded and are not counted.

statistics.timeEstimated: Estimated from when your answers were given
statistics.noTimeYet: Too few answers in a row to tell yet
statistics.timeByDay: Time studied each day, the last {count} days
statistics.timeByDayLabel: Bars for about how many minutes were studied on each of the last {count} days.
statistics.timeDayContinued: {date}: {time}, carrying on a session from the day before.
statistics.showHours: Show when in the day you study
statistics.hours: Answers by hour of the day
statistics.hoursLabel: Bars for the answers given in each hour of the day, from the hour your study day begins.
statistics.hoursNote: In your current time zone: an answer given in another time zone counts by the hour it was here. The hours start when your study day begins, so one study day reads as one run.
statistics.pointAtHour: Point at an hour (or use the arrow keys) to see its answers, or open the table below.

studio.name: Solid Memo Studio
studio.tagline: Manage the decks in your Solid Pod.
studio.loadFailed: The Studio could not be opened. Reload the page to try again.

proseField.markdownHint: Headings, lists, code, tables and links, as the course player shows them. Off, the text is shown as typed, a blank line starting a new paragraph.

importUrl.heading: Add from a link
importUrl.intro: Anyone can publish a deck or a course in their Pod. Paste the link to its release to see what it is, then add it to your decks as you would one from the library.
importUrl.label: Link to the release
importUrl.notLibrary: This is not in Solid Memo's library: it is published on {host}. Solid Memo checked that it can read it, not what it says. Your copy remembers where it came from, and nothing is written there.
